import os

import ops
from ops import testing

captured = {}


class MyCharm(ops.CharmBase):
    def __init__(self, framework):
        super().__init__(framework)
        framework.observe(self.on.install, self._on_install)

    def _on_install(self, event):
        captured["cwd"] = os.getcwd()
        captured["charm_dir"] = str(self.charm_dir)


def test_cwd_matches_charm_dir():
    launch_cwd = os.getcwd()
    ctx = testing.Context(MyCharm, meta={"name": "test-charm"})
    ctx.run(ctx.on.install(), testing.State())
    print(f"\nlaunch_cwd  = {launch_cwd!r}")
    print(f"hook cwd    = {captured['cwd']!r}")
    print(f"charm_dir   = {captured['charm_dir']!r}")
    assert captured["cwd"] == captured["charm_dir"], (
        f"cwd inside hook is {captured['cwd']!r} but charm_dir is "
        f"{captured['charm_dir']!r} -- under real juju these match"
    )
